title: calliandra tehuantepecensis
intro: Calliandra tehuantepecensis, commonly known as the Tejuino or Mexican Bird of Paradise, is a type of flowering plant native to Mexico. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calliandra tehuantepecensis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
